book.name: 1 Uyohana
book.title: Ubvur uwu inggbaashia Uyohana aka atsɛng

content: Àka anyã nggaa ibibema iyɛ Utɛ aka abema umɛn, ngge itsu umbɔ ayisa umɛn angwɛ̃ Unum! Umɛn iwe rimi hã! Upfung usi ihwɛngkpɔ unga, ngge itsu ukpɔ usi ihwɛngkpɔ umɛn.

A aze awɛrhɛ, icɛrɛ umɛn iwu angwɛ̃ Unum, anasi idɛyiwambɔ umɛn ubinkpi umɛn iki iwe. Bɔr umɛn ihwɛngmɛn ugɛ Ukiristo aba adzekanga, umɛn iwuri iwe ru nyaka unga, ubinkutsu, umɛn iwuri inyãmɛn unga aka awe.
Ubɛn unera aka awe ru ifosa iyɛrɛ ru unga, aka isaka asare itsinga ru nyaka unga aka awe asasar.
Ubɛn unera aka awe ra arhim azharhuwe ikpem, idzidzɛrhe arhim awu ida ikpem.
Bɔr umbi ahwɛngmbi ugɛ unga adzeka, ngge ítsu unga ama asorhuwa arhimmɛn. Ikɛi ru unga arhim ashike.
Unera ashia aka isei ru unga na anu ikorha arhim. Uner uwuku unu ikorha arhim anasi inyãã unga use ahwɛnga unga.
A aze awɛkaci, àka niba aneke unera adarha umbi ayapumbi. Uwuruwi aki ikorhi iyiki irhika unga awu uner uwuku urhurhika, ru nyaka Ukiristo aka awu uner uwuku urhurhika.
Unga uwuku unu ikorhe abin arhim unga awe uwu Undenggũ, ubinkutsu, Undenggũ awu ra arhim utsɛku ri inggbaashia. Ubin hã nukpɔ uku utsu Ungwɛ̃ Unum adzeka ru upfung, unga aba itsĩme itser Undenggũ.
Unerwi Unum aka amar asi ídɛ̃ɛ̃nga itser arhim, ubinkutsu, ikpũ iyi Unum iwengge ru unga. Asi ídɛ̃ɛ̃ akorhumbɔ itser arhim, ubinkutsu Unum amar unga.

Ubin hã uku itsu umɛn ihwɛng abikasong awe angwɛ̃ Unum nu abikasong awe angwɛ̃ Undenggũ. Ubɛn unera aka asi ikorhunga abinkɛ aka arhika asi iwea ungwɛ̃ Unum, nu ubɛn unera aka asi ibemunga ungwɛ̃mbɔ use unapumbɔ.
Ibema adɔka
Isarhe ha iyɛ umbi aka agũ ri inggbaashia ugɛ, umɛn ibema adɔka.
Niba awembi ru nyaka Ukayinu, aka awe uwu undenggũ na afɛruka ungwɛ̃mbɔ. Awu use utsu unga afɛre unga? Ubinkutsu, itsernga iwu iyiki ibewe bɔr iyi ungwɛ̃mbɔ iwe iyiki irhika.
Niba agũmbi idzeu, umbi angwɛ̃mɛn nu anapumɛn, upfung uba ukpɛ̃kpɔ umbi.
Umɛn ihwɛngmɛn ugɛ umɛn iki itɔng akpe izĩmɛn urhɛ, ubinkutsu, umɛn ibemumɛn angwɛ̃mɛn nu anapumɛn. Ubɛn unera aka asi ibemunga undɔka, awu ra akpe.
Ubɛn unera aka akpɛ̃ɛ̃ ungwɛ̃mbɔ use unapumbɔ, unga awu uwuku ufɛr aner. Umbi ahwɛngmbi agɛ uner uwuku ufɛr aner ashia ru urhɛ uwu ugbagbaa ru unga.
Umɛn ihwɛngmɛn ibibema iki iwe, ubinkutsu Uyesu Ukiristo adzowe urhɛnga ri itsimɛn. Imɛ̃ngge umɛn indzowe urhɛmɛn ri itsi angwɛ̃mɛn nu anapumɛn.
Unera aba awea ra abin aki upfung na anyã ungwɛ̃mbɔ use unapumbɔ aka abee na asi igũa atorh unga, ibibemu Unum ikorhu uguse iwe ru unga?
A aze awɛkaci, umɛn niba ibemumɛn nggu irhɛm arherhe ra angwĩ ukpekũ, bɔr umɛn ikũ itser nu idzidzɛrhe indɛyiwe.
Akɛrɛ ha awuri itsu umɛn ihwɛng ugɛ umɛn iwemɛn ri idzidzɛrhe, umɛn idɛ̃ɛ̃ itsu amɛnmɛn awoshuke ra asunga,
amɛnmɛn aba atsukake umɛn uvau. Unum ananga amɛnmɛn, na ahwɛnga abina kishoo.
Umbi awɛrhɛ, amɛnmɛn aba asi itsukake umɛn uvau, umɛn iwemɛn ri ikeramɛn ra asu Unum
ni iyɛi ubɛn ubinkpi umɛn iki irhusa unga, ubinkutsu umɛn idɔsi ikpemnga ni ikorhu ubinkpi unga aka abema.
Ikpemnga hã iyɛ, iwe ru imangmang ru Ungwɛ̃nga Uyesu Ukiristo, ni ibema adɔka ru nyaka unga aka atsu ri ikpem.
Abika adɔsi ikpemnga asei ru unga, nu unga asei ru umbɔ. Umɛn ihwɛng ugɛ unga awe ru umɛn, ubinkutsu, Ipfunga ha unga aka adzaa umɛn.
